::: {#def-gibbs-sampler}
#### Gibbs sampler

The **Gibbs sampler** produces $\vparam^{(t+1)}$ from $\vparam^{(t)}$
by updating one component at a time:
for $k = 1, \ldots, K$ in turn,
it draws $\param_k^{(t+1)}$ from the [full conditional distribution](#def-full-conditional) of $\param_k$,
with each other component set to its most recent value
[@dobson4e, Chapter 13, p. 293].
:::
